scene: You step onto the breezy roof among glowing aerials and radio dishes.
picture: A side-scrolling flat view of the windy rooftop. On the far left sits the open metal service elevator cage. To its right is a small broadcast shed with an illuminated sign. The curly-haired boy stands left-centre, camera ready, facing a blinking dish tripod at centre and a brass telescope on the far right.
shown: a corrugated metal broadcast shed with a glowing 'ON AIR' sign on the left
a blinking satellite dish on an adjustable metal tripod in the centre
a brass coin-operated rooftop telescope mounted beside the railing on the far right

variants.scene: Cool evening air greets you on the high rooftop under glowing radio masts.
A warm amber light hums above the metal door against the purple twilight.
High above the twinkling city streets, you hum {tune} beside the humming antennas.
